purpose: Machine-readable consolidation of the thread's world-systems decisions, diffs, required systems, naming replacements, and implementation order.
source_context: Outstanding decisions: Root-Masks, alchemy tiers, Thirteen Tolls, spirit relation-pressure, root corruption, crafting model.
World Consequence Engine additions: degradation/growth curves, stereotomic governance, static MoE byte router, diplomacy observer, crafting/worldstate/voxel-building integration.
Additional stereotomic patterns: Superior-Dexter, Central-Third, Ad Quadratum, Ad Triangulum, Tas-de-Charge, Constraint DAG, Chaos Perturbation, Ratio Policy, Primitive Priors.

files.description: Human-readable mirror for tooling that prefers YAML.

forbidden_or_deprecated.Cree: Do not use in Ironroot-facing system names.
forbidden_or_deprecated.Mooncalling: Replace with Thirteen Tolls / Tolllight / Starfall system naming.
forbidden_or_deprecated.Elemental Reaction Coordinator: Superseded by World Consequence Engine / Consequence Grammar.
forbidden_or_deprecated.faction reputation only: Superseded by Witness-Liability Ledger / Diplomacy Observer.

design_laws: Ironroot is the World Consequence Engine made diegetic.
World systems resolve through one consequence grammar.
Physics resolves before diplomacy interprets.
Gradual processes use precompiled curves; WCE fires only on threshold events.
Root state controls volatility, predictability, cascade probability, and threshold perturbation.
Crafting is intentional consequence shaping.
Voxel buildings are consequence-aware civic structures, not static props.
Worldstate is the active sum of consequence records, not passive save data.
Sound, colour, particles, and camera feedback are downstream consequence outputs.
No runtime retraining. Models are static baked physics compression only.
No float-critical simulation in the hot path.
Primitive priors must provide deterministic fallback for low-confidence material/world interactions.
Every catastrophic system must have readable tells and counterplay.

world_lock.text: Ironroot world systems resolve through one grammar: Authority decides order. Threshold decides whether. Ratio decides spread. Convergence decides apex. DAG decides limit. Root state decides volatility. Primitive priors decide safe fallback. Diplomacy decides meaning after physics has already happened.

curves.description: Degradation, growth, fatigue, pressure, resonance, rot, rust, freezing, fermentation, and root pressure accumulate through O(1) counters until threshold crossing.
curves.event_rule: Only threshold crossings generate WCE queries.
examples: bard sustained resonance shatters stone after counter threshold
root pressure under foundation triggers surge
water erosion lowers terrain only at threshold
corpse decay produces disease/plume/remains at threshold

moe_router.description: Static baked byte router compresses known physics/material outcomes into deterministic consequence classification.
moe_router.inference_path: forge-hal trait seam; CPU selected for tiny experts unless model grows.
moe_router.determinism: Model weights content-addressed; save/replay stores model hash.

governance_layer.description: Records provenance, priority, readability, replay, counterplay, and liability for every major consequence.

bands.upper_third: overpressure; cap, rupture, surge, shatter, or overflow

Tas-de-Charge.wce_role: Three or more source convergence into compound apex query.

Constraint DAG.rule: Energy decay should usually stop the chain before depth 5.

Chaos Perturbation.rule: Perturbs threshold boundaries, not base laws.

rules: sqrt2 applies to lateral spread only
sqrt3 applies to vertical spread only
phi is decorative or organic only, never structural physics

Primitive Priors.wce_role: Deterministic fallback when model confidence is low.

root_stain.definition: Passive corruption from consequence, death, residue, neglect, failed prevention, and careless handling.

root_tithe.definition: Active offering of identity, memory, body, name, material, or civic safety for advantage.

worldstate.role: Authoritative active sum of consequence records.

rules: Use correct hydraulic radius A/P, never volume as hydraulic radius.
Flux is computed canonically per face: lower cell index owns the face flux.
CFL violations trigger integer substeps, not artificial volume clamps.
Surface/open and confined flow blend by fill ratio; no binary regime popping.
Rivers are WCE emitters and WCE targets.

fire_heat_plume.role: Combustion, heat, smoke, updraft, oxygen/air information.
rules: Fire on flat terrain spreads with Ad Quadratum.
Smoke, steam, and updraft use Ad Triangulum.
Water/fire opposition resolves through Superior-Dexter plus Central-Third.
Overkill fire can produce vitrify, ash, structural weakening, or panic.

stone_speech_terrain_topology.role: Terrain height, caves, support, slope, foundations, dams, roads, and raised/lowered voxels.

voxel_building_mortise_works.role: Player/NPC-built structures as consequence-aware voxel assemblies.
voxel_building_mortise_works.rule: Sockets do not bypass physics; they change thresholds, priors, or authority deltas.

stereotomic_mapping.Superior-Dexter: Craft authority from skill, station quality, material provenance, celestial timing, witness/legal proof, and root health.
stereotomic_mapping.Tas-de-Charge: Three or more reagent convergence creates masterwork apex outcome.
stereotomic_mapping.Chaos Perturbation: Near-boundary crafts drift based on root state.
stereotomic_mapping.Primitive Priors: Unknown material falls back to class defaults.

diplomacy_witness_liability_ledger.critical_rule: Diplomacy never gates physics. Physics resolves first; diplomacy records responsibility, intent, witnesses, law, and faction interpretation second.

axes.witness_q: Who saw, recorded, or disputes the event.
axes.dependency_q: Faction relies on player's infrastructure or craft.
axes.sovereignty_q: Kingdom/guild control over territory and roads.
axes.root_trust_q: Whether player heals or weaponizes the Root.

guildhalls_kingdoms.role: Persistent civic structures and territory as worldstate consequences.

sound_colour_sensory.role: Every consequence has optional sensory output.
sound_colour_sensory.rule: Sensory outputs are downstream of consequence descriptor; they do not independently decide world logic.

plants_ecology_root.role: Constructive degradation and root-network consequence bus.
rules: Corrupted growth amplifies chains and lowers predictability.
Healing the Root restores conservation and lowers chaos perturbation.
Healing means balanced curves, not maximal growth.

root_masks.description: Root-Masks are astrological horror talent trees and WCE source modifiers.

masks.horror_name: The Pack That Remembers Your Sin
The Eye That Does Not Sleep
The House That Eats Its Builder
The Throne Growing From the Skull

wce_query_schema.packing_note: Maintain existing compact 16-byte query by quantizing/hashing logical fields.

required_repo_modules.purpose: WCE query/consequence schemas, stereotomic gate, MoE/prior router, budget enforcement.
Integer 120Hz shallow water, rivers, floods, erosion, freeze, steam bridge.
Voxel building schema, sockets, load/support, ownership/liability.
Crafting stations and intentional consequence shaping.
Diplomacy observer, intent classes, reputation/legal/market consequences.
Root state volatility, chaos perturbation, surge/withdraw/heal/feed loop.
Calendar/celestial context, season, tides, craft windows, star/moon modifiers.
Sound, colour, particle, camera, accessibility outputs.
Plant/root growth curves, Ulam scatter, L-systems, Voronoi roots.
Use-based dynamic progression mirroring WCE governance: ProgressionQuery, GrowthDescriptor, SkillCurves, discoveries, dialogue, Root Harmony, Root-Mask attractor fields.

repo_ingestion_checks: All public names must pass no-Cree-facing-name lint.
All world mutations must have a consequence descriptor.
All catastrophic curves must define readable tells and counterplay.
All diplomacy deltas must include provenance.
All replayable outputs must store model/content hash.
All ratio use must pass Ratio Policy.
All long-running processes must be curve-based, not per-tick model inference.
All low-confidence model outputs must fall back to Primitive Priors.
All structure damage must include owner/liability fields where applicable.
All crafting outputs must include provenance_hash.
ProgressionQuery must be exactly 16 bytes.
GrowthDescriptor must be exactly 8 bytes.
Every XP award must cite a domain and action_tag.
Every major discovery must have discovery_id and source context.
Every multi-skill action must pass skill_credit_arbitration.
Every repeated-action loop must update streak.
Every fatigue-causing action must update fatigue or explicitly opt out.
Root Harmony changes must be signed and auditable.
Dialogue progression must go through ProgressionQuery, not bespoke branch-only XP.
Root-Mask unlocks must use attractor fields, not hard class selection.
No runtime retraining.
PrimitiveProgressionPrior required for unknown actions.

character_consequence_engine.purpose: Machine-readable additive patch mapping character progression to the same governance grammar as the World Consequence Engine.

core_thesis.short: Character progression is the player's personal consequence engine.
core_thesis.long: The world changes because sources act on targets. The character changes because the player acts on the world. Both use the same governance grammar, curve logic, query/descriptor pattern, root flux, celestial context, and deterministic consequence accounting.

design_laws: Progression is not external reward; progression is personal worldstate.
Character growth mirrors world consequence.
Use-based progression should feel UO/EQ-like: slow, contextual, and rewarding.
Skill gain is governed by Central-Third difficulty bands.
Superior-Dexter decides which skill receives primary credit when multiple domains apply.
Tas-de-Charge creates mastery outcomes when three or more skills converge.
Streak and fatigue suppress repetitive grind loops.
Discovery outputs are as important as XP.
Root Harmony affects both player progression and local world physics.
Root-Mask branches are attractor fields, not hard talent trees.
Dialogue is a progression domain.
No runtime retraining; static tables/models may be baked from authored progression curves.

world.meaning: Source acts on target and world state changes.

character.meaning: Player acts on world and character state changes.

new_required_module.purpose: Use-based dynamic progression using the same consequence grammar as WCE.

files.purpose: ProgressionQuery packing, alignment checks, validation, and helper constructors.
GrowthDescriptor flags, bit helpers, and application helpers.
Precompiled skill gain curves and Central-Third skill gate.
Gather, craft, build, social, root, secret, combat domains.
Diminishing returns, anti-grind state, reset conditions.
Fatigue cost and recovery interaction with campfires, rest, travel, and social context.
Recipe, route, secret, title, dialogue, and worldstate unlock outputs.
Dialogue roads and social skill progression.
Player relationship to Ironroot and bidirectional progression/world effects.
Static baked progression router or deterministic primitive progression table.
Applies GrowthDescriptor to player state, diplomacy, root state, discoveries, and fatigue.

ProgressionQuery.description: Packed context for a player action that may produce skill growth, discovery, reputation, fatigue, or root shift.

fields.name: action_intensity
fields.description: How well or forcefully the action was performed.

fields.name: target_difficulty
fields.description: Fish rarity, ore tier, debate difficulty, structure complexity, mob level, root pressure, etc.

fields.name: current_skill
fields.description: Primary skill value in relevant domain.

fields.name: tool_quality
fields.description: Rod, bow, forge, hammer, station, guildhall bench, legal document, etc.

fields.name: zone_affinity
fields.description: Whether the zone favours this action.

fields.name: celestial
fields.description: Thirteen Tolls / season / darkness / conjunction context.

fields.name: discovery_state
fields.description: First-time / known / mastered / exhausted status for this context.

fields.name: chaos_phase
fields.description: Tick + celestial + position phase for rare moments.

GrowthDescriptor.description: Compact growth output applied to character, discoveries, reputation, fatigue, and root state.

SkillCurve.rule: Skill gain occurs when action difficulty falls inside the Central-Third band for the player's current skill.

CentralThird.world_use: Threshold: whether a material/world event happens.
CentralThird.character_use: Skill gate: too easy gives little/no XP, sweet spot gives gain, too hard gives failure-learning or none.

progression_rule.sweet_spot: primary_xp scales with difficulty and action intensity

SuperiorDexter.world_use: Authority order for competing world consequences.
SuperiorDexter.character_use: Credit arbitration when one action touches multiple skills.
SuperiorDexter.progression_rule: Highest authority skill receives primary XP; eligible secondary skill receives secondary XP if inside Central-Third.

TasDeCharge.world_use: Three or more source convergence becomes apex consequence.
TasDeCharge.character_use: Three or more skills converge into mastery proc, rare discovery, or quality jump.

ConstraintDAG.character_use: Caps recursive unlock chains per action.
ConstraintDAG.rule: One action may cause XP, discovery, title, and root shift, but recursive unlock expansion must stop within max depth.

ChaosPerturbation.world_use: Controlled threshold shift for unpredictable events.
ChaosPerturbation.character_use: Rare lucky catch, secret discovery, mastery proc, or unusual dialogue opening.
ChaosPerturbation.rule: Chaos changes near-boundary outcomes only; it does not replace curves.

PrimitivePriors.world_use: Safe fallback for low-confidence material/world interactions.
PrimitivePriors.character_use: Safe fallback for unclassified actions or new skills.
PrimitivePriors.rule: If router/table cannot classify, award conservative XP/fatigue only; no major unlock.

ThirteenTollsContext.world_use: Season, moon, tide, crafting window, and celestial seed.
examples: secret reading stronger in Ash/deep dark
root tending altered by hidden toll

RootFluxContext.character_use: Discovery, root harmony, skill drift, and local WCE behavior around player.
RootFluxContext.rule: Character build can locally alter how predictable the world is near the player.

skill_credit_arbitration.rule: When one action maps to multiple skills, credit goes to the skill with highest authority while secondary XP may be awarded if Central-Third conditions are met.

example.resolution: Superior-Dexter picks primary credit; remaining eligible domains may receive secondary XP or discovery flags.

streak_and_fatigue.fatigue_rule: Fatigue suppresses XP, increases failure chance, and may alter dialogue or combat performance.
streak_and_fatigue.anti_grind_rule: The optimal path should be deep engagement, not repeated identical inputs.

0_50.description: Normal progression and normal world response.

51_100.description: Nature skills boosted; natural materials and ecology discoveries improve; corrupted zones resist the player.

101_150.description: Destruction, mining, combat, and building pressure skills improve; natural zones provide less XP.

151_200.description: Can hear root network; secret locations and rare plants become visible; corruption causes psychic cost.

201_255.description: Can temporarily command root pressure; natural creatures become hostile; root surges may target the player.

root_harmony.rule: Character build changes how WCE behaves near the player.

root_mask_progression_diff.before: Root-Masks have masculine, feminine, shadow, and vowless branches.
root_mask_progression_diff.after: Root-Masks have masculine, feminine, shadow, and vowless attractor fields. Player behavior moves them through the field; nodes unlock when skill, worldstate, and root-harmony thresholds align.
impact: Progression emerges from repeated world interaction.
Shadow increases through compulsion, not selection.
Vowless increases through refusal, restraint, cancelled escalation, and chosen non-participation.
Masculine/feminine polarities act as attractors, not mutually exclusive tracks.

attractor_fields.shadow: compulsive repetition, false witness, identity-cost shortcuts, root feeding
attractor_fields.vowless: refusal, restraint, cancellation, accepting loss to prevent corruption

fallback.name: PrimitiveProgressionPrior
fallback.rule: If an action cannot be classified, apply conservative fatigue and optional tiny XP only; no major discovery or title.
